text: ■Next Mission\nMove from Raden Tower to\nRaden Tower: Air Vent to start.
There's an air vent in Raden Tower, and you should be able\nto go outside through it! Defeat the enemies in the air vent\nand head out quickly!
Goudvis, the leader of Raela's elite army, stands in your\nway! He's definitely a formidable opponent! Give it your all\nto defeat him!
